supersedes.reason: v2 selected rows by whether two aimed emissions could be measured in pixels (WP-F finding F-5: selection bias) and judged aim with a cross-track speed bound comparable to the bullet speed (F-1). v3 replaces both: the row set is every sample of frozen windows, and aim is a miss distance against the player hitbox.

contract.aim_claim: perpendicular distance from the annotated player centre to the privileged bullet path, in image pixels
contract.aim_miss_px_rationale: TH08's player hitbox is about 3 px across (~1.5 px radius), so a straight path inside 1.5 px of the player centre passes through the target. Fixed by the target size, not by the measured yield.
contract.aim_lookback_frames_rationale: The capture samples the stage clock every 2 frames, so a bullet first seen at frame f was fired at f or f-2. Searching further back manufactures aimed shots out of stray bullets (WP-F F-1).
contract.emission_recency_frames_rationale: At the observed 1.2-2.8 px/frame bullet speeds a bullet fired 64 stage frames ago is 77-180 px from the muzzle and still crossing a 384 px playfield, so the cited emissions belong to the stream being flown, not to a spent volley.
contract.aim_cross_px_per_frame_role: velocity agreement between the pixel-measured motion and the privileged teacher motion; it is a consistency check, never the aim proof
contract.position_px: max measured deviation over the event + 1.0, declared per review after measurement
contract.emission_rule: two aimed emissions with distinct emission frames from one origin cluster (<= 30 px apart) must be visible for the row
contract.player_px: contract-bound to same-hold memory (f2_dataset requires exact equality); only bullet coordinates are independently measured
contract.unknown: replay actions outside the 18-way candidate set stay unknown with zero gradient and are never converted to hold

selection.window_score: count of samples where a contract-qualifying aimed pair exists, then count of samples with a live bullet, then earliest start
selection.window_rule: greedy top-k non-overlapping windows computed from the privileged bullet pool before any pixel work
selection.row_rule: every sample of every selected window is attempted in capture order; a row that cannot carry a contract-valid annotation becomes explicit context_only with its reason, and the yield is reported; no row is ever replaced by a more convenient row
selection.fallback: if a selected window keeps fewer than 48 usable rows the next-ranked non-overlapping window replaces it and the substitution is recorded

review.author: v376-wp-c-agent-visual-20261105
review.pixel_measurement: brightness-weighted centroid inside a 15x15 window around the memory-predicted point, from the original PNG bytes
review.independent_recheck: separate implementation; still an AI agent, not a human reviewer

actions.clock: replay logic frame; stageFrames is only the image key

training.selection: best mean validation loss over supervised validation windows; test never consulted

evaluation.population: supervised rows inside the scored burnin16/sequence32 windows of the named split
metrics: class-balanced accuracy (mean per-class recall over classes present)
action-change accuracy (rows whose action differs from the previous row's actual action)
hold-last baseline (predict the previous row's actual action)
majority-class baseline (most frequent action in train)
pixel ablation: re-evaluate with the playfield region zeroed, to expose a shortcut that ignores the picture
supervision census: supervised rows, actions, action changes, per event
evaluation.reporting: validation metrics are reported for every epoch's selected checkpoint; test metrics are produced once by a separately invoked sealed evaluation
evaluation.claim_limitation: with a few hundred supervised rows over three replays of one stage this is a signal/plumbing measurement, not an estimate of gameplay skill or generalization

stopping: any exact audit, identity, alignment or pixel-binding failure
fewer than three independent replay source groups
NaN or non-finite loss, updates=0, or a changed backbone
validation has no supervision so selection is impossible
test consulted before the protocol is frozen

authorisation.training: granted by the user for this round after the WP-F findings are fixed: one-update integration, then the frozen-budget run above
authorisation.deployment: not granted; default model, canonical image and deployment entry stay unchanged
